result.rationale: Retain one active E360S platform. BlackRock closed a majority purchase on 2023-02-16; the Competition Bureau names BlackRock Global Infrastructure Fund IV, SCSp, not GEPIF III. BlackRock's 2024 GIP acquisition did not itself transfer E360S or create another owner period. Current disclosures show BlackRock majority, Ardellini significant and CBGF minority; no platform exit was found.
